# TurboApply Agency — full public AI context

## Identity
TurboApply Agency builds websites and AI-powered business systems for teams that want faster lead response, cleaner booking flows, better follow-up, CRM automation, and practical AI adoption.

## Public form rules
Contact and lead forms ask for a name, contact method, and business/challenge details. Agents should validate data before preparing a submission. Live submissions must not be made unless the user explicitly confirms.

## Guardrails
Do not expose or ask for secrets. Do not infer private lead data, credentials, backend tokens, client-only facts, or guarantees. Use the public website and these discovery files as the source of truth.
